parameters.content:
## FLOW 1: Live call tools
Vapi calls this webhook DURING the call.
- check_availability: reads Google Calendar, returns free slots
- book_appointment: re-checks the slot, creates the event, logs it in the sheet (safe if Vapi re-sends the same call)
- update_appointment: confirm or cancel a booking
Every branch answers Vapi with { results: [ { name, toolCallId, result } ] }.

## FLOW 2: After every call
Vapi sends an end-of-call report -> AI extracts intent, outcome, sentiment, urgency -> logged in the 'Calls' tab (upsert on call_id) -> urgent / negative / unfinished calls trigger a Slack alert with the recording link.

## FLOW 3: Reminder calls (Mon-Fri 4 PM)
Finds tomorrow's 'booked' appointments -> Vapi calls each customer with the Reminder assistant -> the customer confirms or cancels -> sheet + calendar updated. Only call people who booked and gave their number.

## SETUP CHECKLIST
1. Google Sheet with tabs 'Appointments' and 'Calls' (use the CSV templates)
2. Credentials: Vapi Server Secret (Header Auth, name X-Vapi-Secret), Vapi API Key (Header Auth, Authorization: Bearer ...), Google Calendar, Google Sheets, OpenAI, Slack
3. Edit 'Business Config' (name, timezone, hours)
4. Replace YOUR_CALENDAR_ID, YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID, YOUR_SLACK_CHANNEL_ID, YOUR_REMINDER_ASSISTANT_ID, YOUR_VAPI_PHONE_NUMBER_ID
5. Create the 2 assistants in Vapi (vapi-assistants.json), set their server URL to this webhook's PRODUCTION URL
6. Activate the workflow, then call your Vapi number
7. Set the Error Handler workflow in Settings -> Error workflow
8. Do NOT enable 'Retry on fail' on Google Calendar create nodes
